title: AgentSpecV1
description: Canonical cross-runtime agent manifest schema for Kubona (Go Core and Python runtimes)

description.description: Description of agent expertise and scientific scope

system_prompt.description: Base system prompt instructing agent behavior

mode.description: Agent operational mode: conversational prompt persona or deterministic tool pipeline

steps.description: Sequential tool steps executed when mode is pipeline

capabilities.description: Functional domain capabilities declared by the agent

modalities.description: Input/output data modalities supported (text, molecule_3d, circuit_qir, spectroscopy, image)

preferred_model.description: Model preference hint (empty string denotes unpinned, resolved at dispatch)

mcp_tools.description: MCP tools whitelisted for direct agent invocation

spend_budget_usd.description: Autonomous spend budget ceiling in USD

memory_scopes.description: Memory and hindsight scopes accessible to this agent

scopes.description: Gateway authorization scopes granted to this agent

created_by.description: Parent creator identity or operator principal

is_system_agent.description: Immutable flag reserved for built-in platform personas
